content:
Rumors suggest that the AirPods 5 will debut next week alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12, as well as the iPhone Ultra. Here's what's currently known about the new AirPods.

The AirPods 5 are expected to be unveiled at the September 9 event, offered in two models, but without a camera.

Apple's annual biggest event will be held next week on September 9. In addition to new iPhone and Apple Watch models, and possibly some home products, the AirPods 5 are also expected to launch at the same time.

The AirPods 4 launched in 2024, and Apple's historical AirPods update cycle is typically two to three years. The original AirPods launched in 2016, AirPods 2 in 2019, AirPods 3 in 2021, and AirPods 4 in 2024. Based on this timeline, launching a new product this year roughly fits the established pattern.

However, rather surprisingly, there haven't been all that many rumors and leaks about the new AirPods.

In recent months, most rumors about the AirPods have revolved around a new model equipped with a camera. Earlier, a video leaked from inside Apple showed a model with a camera, leading to speculation that it was about to launch.

However, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has stated that AirPods with a camera won't arrive until 2027. But he expects the AirPods 5 without a camera to debut at Apple's September event. He wrote earlier:

In another post on X, Gurman added that the AirPods 5 will come in two different models:

  • With Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
  • Without ANC

In an earlier report, Gurman mentioned that he expects the AirPods 5 won't feature the heart rate sensor found on the AirPods Pro 3, but that Apple is "looking into adding more health features to the AirPods in the future, including a body temperature sensor." He also mentioned separately that Apple is developing an "H3 chip designed to reduce latency and improve audio quality."

Whether the AirPods 5 will use the H3 chip remains unknown. When Apple initially launched the H2 chip, it was exclusive to the AirPods Pro lineup.

However, new health sensors could potentially be added to the AirPods 5, and the H3 chip is also one possibility. Beyond that, details about the AirPods 5 are still quite limited at this point. Or, just as with the AirPods Max 2 launched earlier this year, Apple may still surprise us when it unveils the AirPods 5.

What features would you like to see on Apple's next-generation AirPods? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
